implementation.stage_contract_target: Document -> StoreView -> Engine -> re_renderer draws directly into a presentable shared Surface -> Makepad displays the Surface handle. No CPU readback, no CPU re-upload, no per-frame Texture recreation, no GPU blit from a final Texture into the shared surface.
implementation.stage_contract_known_boundary: re_renderer output is RGBA8 sRGB; Makepad IOSurface is fixed BGRA8 linear. Sharing as-is gives colour corruption or a wgpu validation error. Requires a format-specifiable IOSurface API in the Makepad fork.

evidence.timing_measurement: NEVER measure frame timing on target/debug. Use --profile preview (release-equivalent opt + incremental). The 2026-08-25 measurement (Stage median 57.654ms, ImageBuffer::new 46.578ms, readback 10.344ms) was taken on a debug binary and is INVALID: 46.578ms for an 8.3MB zero-fill is ~180MB/s, i.e. unoptimised byte-wise zeroing, which release lowers to memset (<1ms). Re-measure before claiming any dominant cost. See AGENTS.md "実窓を見る時".
